entries.reason: Host resident registry rescan (5 min) and status heartbeat (60 s). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer. The heartbeat goes in step 3.
Starting heartbeat while the runtime starts; it stops once the runtime settles. ADR-0602 step 3 replaces it with on-demand liveness.
A held Node resident rereads the writer coordinate while it waits for admission. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: KNOWLEDGE_WORKER_ADMISSION_POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: The hold wait above.
Restarts a crashed knowledge worker after 60 s; it is armed only after a failure, never while idle.
Bounded readiness wait while a requested runtime starts; it ends at its deadline.
Recovery check for a missed repository watch (60 s). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Debounce that re-arms once while a refresh is still running; it is armed only by a file change.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Change loop cadence for the Node knowledge loop (60 s). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Watchdog reset for each change line a peer sends; it is armed only while a peer stream is open.

entries.name: fallbackIntervalMs
entries.reason: Recovery cadence when a peer cannot be watched. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: fullReadIntervalMs
entries.reason: Full reread of accepted results (15 min). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Supervision change loop with idle backoff (5 s to 5 min). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Lease renewal while a managed process runs; it ends with the process.

entries.name: FULL_OBSERVATION_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Full supervision observation at least every 15 min. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Authority revalidation while a reasoning effect runs; it ends with the effect.

entries.name: presenceFullReadIntervalMs
entries.reason: Full reread of request presence (15 min). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Result branch change loop (60 s). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Bounded 10 ms retry while another process initializes the coordination home; it ends when the lock is taken or its attempts run out.

entries.name: PROBE_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Rate limit for a retention probe inside one read; it is not a timer.
Lease renewal while a convergence assignment runs; it ends with the assignment.

entries.name: RENEWAL_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: The lease renewal above.

entries.name: PUBLICATION_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Age bound for a cached publication probe, compared on read; it is not a timer.

entries.name: POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Admission wait base (1 s), used only while a waiter queues. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: MAXIMUM_POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Admission wait ceiling (8 s), used only while a waiter queues. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Admission lease renewal while a full cycle holds the slot; it ends with the cycle.
Admission and release-confirmation waits while a waiter queues or a release is confirmed. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: KNOWLEDGE_PUBLICATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Recheck delay while publication checks run. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Resident heartbeat (45 s), health age refresh, owner lease renewal, continuity tick and hold-release check. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer. The heartbeats go in step 3.
Resident reconcile timer with idle backoff, and the wake debounce that a running cycle re-arms through its pending flag. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces the reconcile timer with one earliest-deadline timer.
Source and authority check while a provider call runs; it ends with the call.
Validation while a provider probe runs; it ends with the probe.
Hold heartbeat while a resident waits for admission. ADR-0602 step 3 replaces it with on-demand liveness.

entries.name: RESIDENT_PROJECTION_EVENT_INTERVAL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Projection event refresh bound (5 min). ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.
Upgrade-waiting check while a cycle runs, so an upgrade preempts it; it ends with the cycle. ADR-0602 step 2 replaces it with one earliest-deadline timer.

entries.name: UPGRADE_PREEMPTION_POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: The upgrade-waiting check above.
Restarts the repository watch 60 s after it failed; it is armed only after a failure and stops once a watch is armed.
Discord typing indicator refresh while a reply is being written; Discord drops the indicator after 10 s, and the refresh ends with the reply.

entries.name: DEFAULT_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: The typing indicator refresh above.
Lease renewal while a deliberation runs; it ends with the deliberation.
